methodology.initial: 2 Base + 1 Advanced; choose simultaneously, pass right, add Advanced; all 6 choices free
methodology.recovery: 8 current-tier cards + 4 tokens; each player takes one card and one token; visible lower tiers may replace current tier; unpicked cards return
methodology.tokens: Each physical reward card in a conserved attempt awards one token at module end, no cap by type
methodology.dice: All real engine rules, own-color wild star, persistent freeze, multiple ±1 tokens, full free-dice rerolls
methodology.controllers: Expert public-information bounded search, mild cost preferences; not proven optimal or human behavior
methodology.differencesFromProduction: Sandbox-only catalog/draft/token patches; isolated planner counts all card rewards, uses fresh odds and avoids trial-landing mutations
